integrity_notes: An explicit analytical argument handles every positive part size and every Borel observation-time law. Exact arithmetic and finite calculations reproduce core identities but are not an independent audit or an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the unweighted adjacency Hamiltonian, a common arbitrary observation-time law, and global unnormalized squared Frobenius loss are considered. Other norms, site potentials, time budgets and noise are not classified. The completeness of literature overlap screening is not mathematically certifiable.
title: Sharp randomized-time uniformity deficit on complete bipartite quantum walks
